title: Breaking change in XunitException constructors

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: A fault in an existing feature

body:
The cleanup of `XunitException` constructors in https://github.com/xunit/assert.xunit/commit/889441b0cfd5c2788bd6ec723c113c1bd34e0aec breaks anyone using `Activator.CreateInstance` to call the message-only overload.

For example, [Fluent Assertions uses this](https://github.com/fluentassertions/fluentassertions/blob/60d659a34e53cc0faef5d62d166b20bd40a566c3/Src/FluentAssertions/Execution/XUnit2TestFramework.cs#L38C26-L38C50) and so a recent Xunit preview results in (given a failing assertion):

```
  Message: 
System.MissingMethodException : Constructor on type 'Xunit.Sdk.XunitException' not found.

  Stack Trace: 
RuntimeType.CreateInstanceImpl(BindingFlags bindingAttr, Binder binder, Object[] args, CultureInfo culture)
Activator.CreateInstance(Type type, Object[] args)
XUnit2TestFramework.Throw(String message)
TestFrameworkProvider.Throw(String message)
CollectingAssertionStrategy.ThrowIfAny(IDictionary`2 context)
AssertionScope.Dispose()
EquivalencyValidator.AssertEquality(Comparands comparands, EquivalencyValidationContext context)
ObjectAssertions`2.BeEquivalentTo[TExpectation](TExpectation expectation, Func`2 config, String because, Object[] becauseArgs)
TrackedObjectPersistenceTestsBase`2.AssertEquivalent(TEntity entity1, TEntity entity2)
TrackedObjectPersistenceTestsBase`2.CanAddQueryUpdateAndRemove()
TrackedObjectPersistenceTestsBase`2.CanAddQueryUpdateAndRemove()
```
